name: Code block
summary: Raw code plate: gutter numbers, tone-washed highlight lines, Copy with a held rest.

slots.label: File name
slots.tooltip: The name shown at the top of the plate, like run-local.sh

slots.label: Language
slots.tooltip: A small tag next to the file name saying what kind of code it is, like bash

slots.label: Code
slots.tooltip: The code exactly as it should appear. About 12 short lines fit; longer code is cut off at the bottom.

slots.label: Highlighted lines
slots.tooltip: Line numbers to light up in the slide's colour, counting the first line as 1

item.label: Line number
item.tooltip: Which line to light up (the first line is 1)

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The colour of the highlighted lines and the Copied button
